trigger.description: Create a service to handle webhook events from WSO2 Identity Server

metadata.label: Event Channel
metadata.description: The type of WSO2 Identity Server or Asgardeo webhook event to listen for

section.label: Listener
section.description: Attach the service to a new or existing WSO2 Identity Server webhook listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new WSO2 Identity Server webhook listener in the project.

listenerConfig.label: Listener Configurations
listenerConfig.description: Configure the WSO2 Identity Server webhook listener.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to a WSO2 Identity Server listener already declared in the project.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing listener to attach the service to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Webhook Listener Port
metadata.description: The port on which the webhook listener accepts incoming HTTP requests

metadata.label: Listener Config
metadata.description: Fallback empty value for the listener config record when no fields under it are set.

metadata.label: Webhook Secret
metadata.description: Secret configured on the webhook in the WSO2 Identity Server or Asgardeo Console, used to validate incoming events

metadata.label: Login
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server login is received. Available actions: onLoginSuccess and onLoginFailed.

metadata.label: Registration
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server registration is received. Available actions: onRegistrationSuccess and onRegistrationFailed.

metadata.label: Token
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server token is received. Available actions: onAccessTokenIssued and onAccessTokenRevoked.

metadata.label: Session
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server session is received. Available actions: onSessionEstablished, onSessionPresented, and onSessionRevoked.

metadata.label: Credential
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server credential is received. Available actions: onCredentialUpdated.

metadata.label: User
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server user is received. Available actions: onUserCreated, onUserProfileUpdated, onUserDisabled, onUserEnabled, onUserAccountLocked, onUserAccountUnlocked, and onUserDeleted.

metadata.label: Consent
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server consent is received. Available actions: onConsentAdded and onConsentRevoked.

metadata.label: Consent Purpose
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server consent purpose is received. Available actions: onPurposeVersionAdded.

metadata.label: Role
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server role is received. Available actions: onRoleCreated, onRoleMetaUpdated, onRoleDeleted, onRoleUsersUpdated, onRoleGroupsUpdated, onRoleIdpGroupsUpdated, and onRolePermissionsUpdated.

metadata.label: Organization
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to WSO2 Identity Server organization is received. Available actions: onOrganizationCreated, onOrganizationUpdated, onOrganizationEnabled, onOrganizationDisabled, and onOrganizationDeleted.
